<!--
  The culture of a company: a strip of three pictures, the heading, a few figures and the values. Axes: layout
  (split: the pictures beside the text, stacked: the pictures under it), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type AboutCompanyProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  stats: Stat[];
  values: Feature[];
  layout?: "split" | "stacked";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  stats,
  values,
  layout = "split",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<AboutCompanyProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :layout="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :media="{ show: true, side: 'start' }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Grid cols="2-4" class="gap-4" data-testid="stats">
      <Stack v-for="s in stats" :key="s.id" gap="0" data-testid="stat">
        <Text size="3xl" weight="bold">
          {{ s.value }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ s.label }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
    <Box
      :class="cn('grid grid-cols-1 gap-4', (((layout as string) === 'stacked') ? 'md:grid-cols-3' : ''))"
      data-testid="values"
    >
      <Group
        v-for="v in values"
        :key="v.id"
        gap="4"
        align="start"
        class="border-t border-border pt-4"
        data-testid="value"
      >
        <LucideIcon :name="v.icon" :size="20" />
        <Stack gap="2">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ v.title }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ v.text }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
    </Box>
    <template #aside>
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4" data-testid="strip">
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" />
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" class="mt-8" />
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" />
      </Box>
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
